obligations.description: The product must have folded and unfolded configurations.
There must be exactly three supports, each able to fold adjacent to the body.
The folded envelope must be narrower than the unfolded envelope.
All components must remain attached while folded.
No component is removed or becomes loose during folding or unfolding.
There must exist an ordered sequence of user actions to unfold the device.
The three ground contacts must form a non-collinear triangle.
All components must remain attached throughout the entire unfolding motion.
The device must be operable without tools or external power.
The unfolded configuration must be stable without continuous user support.
In the unfolded configuration, the supports must not be able to fold, twist, or detach.
No unintended rigid-body motion is possible in the unfolded configuration.
Folding must be prevented until a deliberate user action is performed.
The unfolded configuration must withstand a disturbance without collapsing.
There must be a continuous folding path returning to the original folded configuration.
The opening and folding cycle must be repeatable without irreversible steps.
In the unfolded configuration, there must be a region capable of carrying an object.
The product must be assemblable in a sensible order.
All components must remain attached during normal opening and folding.

load_cases.description: User manually unfolds the device on a desk. Forces applied by user on the supports.
Device holds an object on a desk. Gravity acts on the object and device; the object is supported by the device.
User deliberately releases a lock before folding.
Device is knocked while open. A disturbance force acts on the structure.
Device is stored folded. Gravity acts on the structure.
Assembly process: parts are joined with insertion forces.

candidates.description: Three legs hinged to a central body using revolute joints, with a locking mechanism to maintain open configuration.
Three legs sliding radially from a central body using prismatic joints, with a locking mechanism to maintain open configuration.
Three legs with compliant flexures allowing bending, held open by a detent or snap.

acceptance_contracts.statement: There are exactly three supports, each able to fold adjacent to the body.
acceptance_contracts.acceptance_test: MOBILITY_ANALYSIS: verify each support can move from unfolded to folded without collision.

acceptance_contracts.statement: Folded envelope is narrower than unfolded envelope.
acceptance_contracts.acceptance_test: RIGID_KINEMATIC_GEOMETRY: measure envelope dimensions in both configurations.

acceptance_contracts.statement: Unfolded configuration stays open without user support.
acceptance_contracts.acceptance_test: RIGID_BODY_DYNAMICS: apply a small disturbance and verify stability.

acceptance_contracts.statement: Folding requires a deliberate user action.
acceptance_contracts.acceptance_test: RIGID_BODY_DYNAMICS: verify that without action, folding does not occur.
RIGID_BODY_DYNAMICS: apply a specified disturbance and verify no collapse.

acceptance_contracts.statement: Product can be assembled in a sensible order.

unresolved.description: The specific magnitude of the knock disturbance is unknown, preventing quantitative verification of stability.
alternatives: A force magnitude or energy threshold is required.

unresolved.description: The acceptable effort for opening, releasing, and folding is undefined, preventing verification of usability.
alternatives: A force or torque limit is required.

unresolved.description: The required material, strength, wear, and lifetime are unspecified, affecting durability and manufacturing.
The manufacturing process and tolerances are not specified, affecting assembly and cost.

assumptions: The product is a three-legged stand intended for a desk.
The term 'compact' implies a smaller footprint when folded.
The three supports are likely legs that fold inward.
The object to be held is unspecified; its weight is unknown.
No specific material is assumed; a stiff plastic or metal is plausible.
The user can operate the device manually with reasonable force.
The product is stored on a flat surface when folded.
The assembly process is manual, not automated.
